description_en: Peer support groups that meet online throughout the month, led by trained volunteers who live with arthritis themselves. description_en: Free two hour groups for people living with persistent pain, run by trained peer facilitators who live with pain themselves. Each session mixes learning, group discussion and gentle movement. Groups run for regions across British Columbia, and you can join one outside your own region if the timing suits you better.

Des groupes existent pour les régions de la Colombie-Britannique, et vous pouvez joindre celui d'une autre région si l'horaire vous convient mieux.
